documents.implementation_connection: Vary the conditional observation set and record which coefficients are fixed. No claim of statistical identifiability from polynomial invertibility.
Tilt log-probability by linear input; compare one/two-well families. The two-measurement identity requires the same state, not two independently minimized states.
Normalize exp(-beta E) with beta positive. Existing Lean results do not prove the statistical interpretation or exploratory search convergence.
